# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-26

This Xteink X4 Pro release completes the first end-to-end update delivered through the self-hosted CrossPoint OTA service.

## Improved

- Added meaningful Lucide icons to reader actions, OPDS screens, Wi-Fi networks, font downloads, button mapping, and KOReader Sync settings.
- Replaced generic or repeated placeholder icons with icons specific to each action.
- Added a small visual gap between the home-screen book cover and the black top panel.
- Changed the EPUB library action from viewing only the cover to browsing all illustrations, with the cover shown first.

## Notes

- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 Pro only.
- The OTA binary is published through the self-hosted CrossPoint release service rather than GitHub Releases.
